$comment: Blocking project guards, run by scripts/check_guards.py as a pre-commit hook. Add one with the fix that brings its match count to zero. See .agents/skills/coding-standards/SKILL.md rule 5.

guards.why: Every AGENTS.md routing link once used an absolute file:/// URI, which resolves to the filesystem root and is dropped by GitHub's renderer, so the table lost its navigation.
CONTRIBUTING.md's No Bypass Rule: pre-commit hooks are the quality gate, and automation that skips them skips it for every caller.
guards.instead: Run the hooks; skip one specific unavailable tool with SKIP=<hook-id> if you must.
